commit.message:
Initial commit: Enterprise Search Frontend with AI Policy Analyzer

- Added Next.js 15.3.2 enterprise search application
- Implemented AI Policy Analyzer suite with:
  - Policy Analyzer: Document analysis and compliance checking
  - Policy Generator: AI-powered policy creation tool
  - Learn: Knowledge base integration
- Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization for React Server Components
- Updated sidebar navigation with AI Policy Analyzer option
- Added comprehensive UI components and utilities
- Integrated PropelAuth authentication and Zustand state management
- Configured Kubernetes deployment manifests for dev/qa/prod environments
